speaker: Craig Hamilton-Parker (psychic / medium)
context: Pre-Christmas 2019 video about Donald Trump. Mixes the speaker's own forecasts with prophecies he attributes to Nostradamus, Baba Vanga, and ancient Tamil 'Indian Oracles'.
scoring_note: Outcomes reflect real-world events through mid-2026. 'hit/miss/partial' are best-effort judgements; vague or interpretive claims are marked unverifiable.

items.subject: Trump impeachment
items.statement: Trump will be impeached but will NOT be removed from office.
items.outcome_note: Impeached Dec 2019, acquitted by the Senate Feb 2020; not removed.

items.subject: 2020 election
items.statement: Trump will win the U.S. election.
items.outcome_note: Trump lost the 2020 election to Joe Biden.

items.subject: China
items.statement: There will be a political coup and popular uprising in China.
items.outcome_note: No coup or popular uprising has occurred; the CCP remains firmly in power.

items.subject: Russia / Syria
items.statement: Trump will challenge Putin over Syria; West-East tensions manifest in 2019.
items.outcome_note: No notable 2019 Trump-Putin confrontation over Syria materialised.

items.subject: Middle East
items.statement: There will be conflict in the Middle East, with Saudi Arabia drawn into conflict with Iran, pushed by Trump.
items.outcome_note: Saudi-Iran tensions were real, but no open war; the two restored diplomatic ties in 2023.

items.subject: China
items.statement: Trump's pressure will cause the implosion of the Chinese system / a revolution in China.
items.outcome_note: No implosion or revolution occurred.

items.subject: Europe
items.statement: Trump will 'take on Europe' next, after China.
items.outcome_note: Too vague; trade frictions with the EU existed but the claim is not scorable.

items.subject: Trump allies
items.statement: One or two close allies (e.g. Rudy Giuliani) will stab him in the back / do him damage during the proceedings.
items.outcome_note: Giuliani later became a major liability (indicted 2023, disbarred 2024), but not clearly during the 2019-20 proceedings as framed.

items.subject: Future presidency
items.statement: Trump will serve a second term as president 'in the future'.
items.outcome_note: Ambiguous: his immediate framing was winning 2020 (missed), but as a standalone claim of a future second term it came true - Trump won 2024 and was inaugurated Jan 2025.

items.subject: 2020 Democratic primary
items.statement: The final Democratic race will be between Joe Biden and Elizabeth Warren.
items.outcome_note: Biden was in the final; the last real contest was Biden vs Bernie Sanders, not Warren.

items.subject: 2020 Democratic nominee
items.statement: Elizabeth Warren will become the Democratic nominee for president.
items.outcome_note: Warren dropped out in March 2020; Biden was the nominee.

items.subject: Trump demeanour
items.statement: After impeachment Trump will become more fiery and confident on the world stage.
items.outcome_note: Subjective / not scorable.

items.subject: South Korea
items.statement: New problems will arise with South Korea.
items.outcome_note: Too vague to score.

items.subject: North Korea
items.statement: A live North Korean missile will hit somewhere like the sea, and Trump will take a forceful stance.
items.outcome_note: No such live-missile escalation followed; US-NK diplomacy quietly stalled.

items.subject: Assassination attempt
items.statement: There will be an attempt on Trump's life at some stage, but he will not die from it.
items.outcome_note: Two 2024 assassination attempts (Butler PA, 13 Jul 2024; West Palm Beach, 15 Sep 2024); Trump survived both.

items.subject: Trump family
items.statement: A car accident of some sort will affect other members of the Trump family.
items.outcome_note: No widely reported event matching this claim.

items.subject: Indian Oracle (meta)
items.statement: He has located Donald Trump's ancient Tamil Oracle and will reveal its 2020+ predictions in his next video.
items.outcome_note: A promise about forthcoming content rather than a world event.

items.subject: Trump's sanity
items.statement: 'The false trumpet concealing madness' - read as raising questions about Trump's sanity.
items.outcome_note: Interpretive; not scorable.

items.subject: Assassination
items.statement: 'The trumpet shakes with great discord... the bloody mouth will swim with blood... lies on the ground' - interpreted as a possible assassination attempt.
items.outcome_note: Interpretive, but notable given the real 2024 assassination attempts on Trump.

items.subject: Final president
items.statement: The final U.S. president will be a messiah-type personality.
items.outcome_note: Interpretive; not scorable.

items.subject: US division
items.statement: Everyone will put their hopes in him and the opposite will happen - he will bring the country down, and conflict between northern and southern states will escalate.
items.outcome_note: Political division heightened, but no literal north-vs-south state conflict.

items.subject: Religious war
items.statement: A massive 'Muslim war' was prophesied.
items.outcome_note: No such war has occurred; the attribution itself is disputed.

items.subject: Trump 2020 and beyond
items.statement: The ancient Tamil Oracle holds Donald Trump's predictions for 2020 and beyond (content to be revealed later).
items.outcome_note: No substantive Oracle content is delivered in this video; presented as forthcoming.
